description: Transaction status and receipt by hash across 8 EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BNB Chain, Arc and Robinhood): success or revert, from, to, value, contract created, gas used, fee paid, block and time. $0.002 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

chain.description: ethereum (default), base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bnb, arc or robinhood

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.
